title: ResizablePanel
description: A panel component with a draggable resize handle that supports horizontal and vertical resizing.

value.description: Controlled size value of the panel in pixels.

defaultValue.description: Default uncontrolled size value of the panel in pixels.

onValueChange.description: (value: number) => void — Callback fired when the panel size changes.

onResizeStart.description: (value: number) => void — Callback fired when a resize drag begins.

onResizeEnd.description: (value: number) => void — Callback fired when a resize drag ends.

minValue.description: Minimum allowed size value in pixels.

maxValue.description: Maximum allowed size value in pixels.

resizeDirection.description: The panel edge the resize handle sits on. Not `orientation`.

step.description: Step increment for resize value changes.

disabled.description: Whether the resize handle is disabled.

reduceMotion.description: Controls motion preferences. 'auto' respects the user's OS setting.

handleContent.description: React.ReactNode — Custom content rendered inside the resize handle.

unstyled.description: When true, removes all default styling.
